description: Tool to stop watching resources through a notification channel. Use when you need to discontinue push notifications for a specific channel subscription.

id.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this channel.
id.title: Id

resourceId.description: An opaque ID that identifies the resource being watched on this channel. Stable across different API versions.
resourceId.title: Resource Id

token.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification delivered over this channel. Optional.
token.title: Token

name: channels_stop

display_url.description: URL to view this resource in the Google Calendar web UI. None for notification channels (no dedicated UI).
display_url.title: Display Url

success.description: Indicates whether the channel was successfully stopped.
success.title: Success
